title: Promises and async-await
summary: Understand a Promise as a future result, use await inside async functions, and handle rejected work with try/catch.

sketchBlocks.title: A Promise represents a result that may arrive later
try/catch gives rejected work an error path

quizDraft.title: Choose the right idea
quizDraft.prompt: What does `await` do in these beginner async functions?
options: Waits for a Promise result before dependent lines continue
quizDraft.hint: Focus on the responsibility described by the question.

help.concept: The correct option matches the specific job the code needs to do.
help.hint_1: Separate DOM, data, events, and async responsibilities.
help.hint_2: Choose the behavior that directly produces the requested outcome.

quizDraft.title: Recognize correct behavior
options: await is used inside async functions in these examples.
A rejected awaited Promise can reach catch.
Code after await can use the fulfilled value.
quizDraft.hint: More than one statement can be correct.

help.concept: This check separates the responsibilities introduced in the lesson.
help.hint_1: Keep only statements that match the actual JavaScript or browser behavior.
help.hint_2: Reject statements that assign the concept a different job.

quizDraft.title: Await a saved preference
quizDraft.prompt: Problem: A saved preference arrives later, so the page cannot display the value until the asynchronous operation finishes. Task: Inside `showPreference`, await `preferencePromise` and show the result in `#preference`. Expected result: the Preview displays the resolved preference after the Promise completes.
quizDraft.hint: Update the DOM after the awaited value exists.

help.concept: await sequences code that depends on a Promise result.
help.hint_2: Store the awaited value before updating the paragraph.

quizDraft.title: Show a failed sync message
quizDraft.prompt: Problem: A sync operation can fail, and leaving the interface unchanged would make the failure invisible to the user. Task: Await the rejected `syncPromise` inside `try`. In `catch`, change `#sync-status` to `"Sync failed"`. Expected result: the Preview shows a clear failure message when the Promise rejects.
quizDraft.hint: Put normal async work in try and fallback UI in catch.

help.concept: try/catch provides separate success and failure paths around awaited work.
help.hint_2: Use catch to replace the UI with the failure message.
